description: offre de transport du réseau de LAVAL Agglomération (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by LAVAL Agglomération. Dataset of the transport offer of the TUL network of Laval agglomeration. the 34 municipalities of Laval agglomeration: Ahuillé Argentré Beaulieu-sur-Oudon Bonchamp-lès-Laval Bourgon Châlons-du-Maine Changed Entrammes Forced The Brûlatte La Chapelle-Anthenaise The Gravelle Launay-Villiers Laval Le Bourgneuf-la-Forêt The Genest-Saint-Isle The Huisserie Loiron-Ruillé Louverné Louvigné Montflours Montigné-le-Brillant Montjean Nuillé-sur-Vicoin Olivet Parné-sur-Roc Port-Brillet Saint-Cyr-le-Gravelais Saint-Ouën-des-Toits Saint-Pierre-la-Cour Saint-Berthevin ... Coverage: LAVAL Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "transport offer of the LAVAL Agglomeration (GTFS) network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is LAVAL Agglomération. Its keywords include transport-en-commun, bus, gtfs, laval. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2026-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
